summary: Read two texts made only of digit characters. Each text has length at least 1 and at most 200. Treat each text as a non-negative integer. Except for the integer 0 itself, neither text starts with a spare 0. Multiply the two integers and write the product as decimal digit characters, with no spaces and no plus sign. The product may contain more digits than either input text.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
